pages.text: Four trial islands float far apart, each a day's labour and each reached only through its own gate: Solenne's Sun Spire, Vael's Moon Arena, Orrin's Prism Observatory and Ilyra's Endless Library. Each Watcher waits beside its arrival platform - speak to it to begin its trial.$(br2)Each completed trial grants that Watcher's $(l)Mark$() and its $(l)favour$() – but rival Watchers grow cooler: Solenne and Vael, Orrin and Ilyra.
